title: MANUAL-000001 perps controller analytics contract
description: Validate the Extension consumes the @metamask/perps-controller analytics contract (TAT-3463 / core#9311): package version and controller re-exports as contract asserts, per-AC behaviour proved by the owning Jest suites, and a live UI pass over the market-not-found error screen the analytics gating depends on.

gate-repo-root.intent: Ensure the recipe runs from the Extension repo root

ac1-assert-package-version.cmd: node -e "const v=require('./node_modules/@metamask/perps-controller/package.json').version; if(!/^9\\.(?:[1-9]|\\d{2,})\\./.test(v) && !/^9\\.(?:[1-9]|\\d{2,})$/.test(v)) { console.error('unexpected version', v); process.exit(1);} const c=require('@metamask/perps-controller/constants/eventNames'); if(!c.PERPS_EVENT_PROPERTY.ENTRY_POINT || !c.PERPS_EVENT_PROPERTY.HL_FEE_RATE || !c.PERPS_EVENT_PROPERTY.BULK_ACTION_ID || !c.PERPS_EVENT_PROPERTY.SEARCH_QUERY || !c.PERPS_EVENT_PROPERTY.TIME_ON_SCREEN_MS || c.PERPS_EVENT_VALUE.STATUS.SUBMITTED!=='submitted' || c.PERPS_EVENT_VALUE.ACTION.ABANDON_ORDER!=='abandon_order'){ console.error('missing contract keys'); process.exit(1);} console.log('perps-controller', v);"
ac1-assert-package-version.intent: AC1: the installed package is >=9.1 and exports every contract key this PR consumes

ac2-assert-controller-reexports.intent: AC2: the Extension constants layer re-exports the controller contract rather than mirroring it

ac2-assert-no-local-timestamp-mirror.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const t=fs.readFileSync('shared/constants/perps-events.ts','utf8'); if(t.includes(\"TIMESTAMP: 'perps_timestamp'\")){ console.error('local TIMESTAMP mirror still present'); process.exit(1);} console.log('re-export ok');"
ac2-assert-no-local-timestamp-mirror.intent: AC2: no local copy of a controller-owned property key survives

ac3-attribution-behaviour.intent: AC3: attribution wiring proved by behaviour (UTM accumulation, controller setAttributionContext forwarding, mergeAttributionContext on controller-emitted events) instead of identifier greps that go stale on rename

ac4-order-lifecycle-behaviour.intent: AC4: trackingData/hlFeeRate on place, modify, close, cancel and flip proved by the suites that assert the emitted payloads. Serialized (--runInBand) because these suites use userEvent with a 5.5s per-test timeout and flake under parallel load on a busy machine

ac5-assert-no-duplicate-order-entry-clos.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const t=fs.readFileSync('ui/pages/perps/perps-order-entry-page.tsx','utf8'); if(t.includes('MetaMetricsEventName.PerpsPositionCloseTransaction') || t.includes('MetaMetricsEventName.PerpsTradeTransaction') || t.includes('MetaMetricsEventName.PerpsRiskManagement')){ console.error('order-entry still emits duplicate transaction analytics'); process.exit(1);} console.log('order-entry deduped');"
ac5-assert-no-duplicate-order-entry-clos.intent: AC5: absence claim — the client no longer emits controller-owned transaction events. Asserted against the stable MetaMetricsEventName identifiers, which are contract names rather than local variables

ac5-assert-no-duplicate-cancel.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const t=fs.readFileSync('ui/components/app/perps/cancel-order/cancel-order-modal.tsx','utf8'); if(t.includes('PerpsOrderCancelTransaction')){ console.error('cancel modal still emits duplicate cancel analytics'); process.exit(1);} console.log('cancel deduped');"
ac5-assert-no-duplicate-cancel.intent: AC5: the cancel modal does not duplicate the controller cancel event

ac5-assert-no-duplicate-close-modal.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const t=fs.readFileSync('ui/components/app/perps/close-position/close-position-modal.tsx','utf8'); if(t.includes('PerpsPositionCloseTransaction')){ console.error('close modal still emits duplicate close analytics'); process.exit(1);} console.log('close modal deduped');"
ac5-assert-no-duplicate-close-modal.intent: AC5: the close modal does not duplicate the controller close event

ac6-search-funnel-behaviour.intent: AC6 (TAT-3144/TAT-3202): market search funnel — debounced query with settled counts, results/no-results screen views, result_rank on tap, abandonment on clear

ac7-abandonment-behaviour.intent: AC7 (TAT-3136): abandon_order fires on leaving an uncommitted trade surface, once, with time_on_screen_ms, and never after a commit

live-cdp.intent: Confirm the Extension CDP runtime is reachable before live proof

live-ensure-unlocked.intent: Unlock the fixture wallet so Perps routes render

live-open-perps.intent: Open the Perps surface the analytics screen views describe

live-open-unknown-market.intent: Show a market that does not exist (route verified live this session), so the user lands on the not-found state whose screen-view gating this PR fixed

live-assert-error-screen.intent: Prove exactly one error state renders for an unknown symbol, so the single error screen view (and the suppressed asset_details view) describes a real screen

live-capture-error-screen.label: market-not-found-error-screen
live-capture-error-screen.intent: Register the rendered error screen as visual evidence for the gating fix

ac8-geo-block-screen-view.intent: AC8 (TAT-3175 bullet 4): the restriction notice reports screen_type=geo_block_notif once per open and re-arms for the next open
